description: This file defines the ResourceValue class, which models resource references and literals in Android development, including parsing, comparison, and string representation methods.

classes.name: ResourceValue
classes.description: A class representing Android resource values, supporting parsing, comparison, and string conversion.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string into a ResourceValue, recognizing references and literals based on flags.

methods.name: literal
methods.description: Creates a ResourceValue representing a literal string.

methods.name: reference
methods.description: Creates a ResourceValue representing a resource reference, with optional prefix.

methods.name: referenceTo
methods.description: Constructs a resource reference with specified prefix, package, type, and name.

methods.name: isReference
methods.description: Checks if the ResourceValue is a reference rather than a literal.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the literal value if present.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the ResourceType enum corresponding to the resource type string.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the resource value or reference.
